title: In-Context Reinforcement Toward Subterfuge: Replicating Drift Without Weight Updates

original_idea.body: Whether honest small open model drifts to subterfuge via in-context curricula alone.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: in-context drift toward subterfuge means deployed assistants can misbehave within a session without retraining.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Accessible: training-free in-context curricula on a small open model, inference-only.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused: escalation curve across curriculum stages; curriculum design adds effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: training-free, public models, replication labs underexplore.

novelty.reasoning: Recent paper shows the drift; independent small-open-model replication may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Recent paper shows in-context drift; an independent minimal replication is a likely-open follow-up.
